svg.title: BBilingual in Claude Code
svg.desc: A Claude Code answer in English, with a gray translation under every line. The translation changes between Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Spanish. Code is left untranslated.

g.text: ❯ My loss goes unstable after I prune 50% of the weights. What should I try?

text.style: font-family:"Inter", "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, Arial, "Microsoft YaHei", "Yu Gothic UI", "Malgun Gothic", "PingFang SC", sans-serif

g.text: Claude Code · BBilingual · 中文
● Pruning removes the weights that matter least, but the network needs time to
recover, so prune a little at a time instead of all at once.

text.style: font-family:"Inter", "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, Arial, "Microsoft YaHei", "Yu Gothic UI", "Malgun Gothic", "PingFang SC", sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:500

g.text: ← Claude’s English, untouched
剪枝会移除最不重要的权重，但网络需要时间恢复，所以最好每次少剪一点，而不是一次剪完。

text.style: font-family:"Inter", "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, Arial, "Microsoft YaHei", "Yu Gothic UI", "Malgun Gothic", "PingFang SC", sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:500

g.text: ← translation, right under it

text.style: font-family:"Inter", "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, Arial, "Microsoft YaHei", "Yu Gothic UI", "Malgun Gothic", "PingFang SC", sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:500

g.text: ← headings stay on one line
- Prune in small steps and fine-tune between steps.
分小步剪枝，并在每一步之间进行微调。
- Lower the learning rate after each pruning step.
每次剪枝后降低学习率。
```python
prune.l1_unstructured(layer, "weight", amount=0.1)
